data.title: 冬马和纱 · 耳机里的一段旋律
data.description: 她坐在地毯上听录音，手边摊开的谱纸被压在杯垫下面，免得卷起来。
data.action: sitting on the rug and listening through headphones
data.promptProse: Curled up on a worn wool rug in the corner of a dimly lit apartment living room, Kazusa wears bulky vintage studio headphones, her eyes closed as she absorbs a piano concerto. Scattered manuscript scores, an open leather notebook with musical notations, and the soft amber glow of a vacuum-tube amplifier create an intensely private musical haven.
